subject: general
question: The prices (in Rs.) for the commodity ABC, XYZ, MNO, and IJK in base year (2020) are 20, 18, 12, 24 and in current year (2022) ae 25, 22, 15, 28 respectively. The value of price index by simple aggregative method is
solution:
The correct answer is **121.62**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **simple aggregative method** is a price index calculation method that combines the prices of multiple commodities into a single index.
 
• The formula for the simple aggregative method is as follows:
 
• **Price index = (Price of basket in current year) / (Price of basket in base year) * 100**
